raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation This PR enables `--dcp-size > 1` for the RoPE DSA models on the `triton` DSA backends, which is the path ROCm runs. Previous work [#43735](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43735) brought DCP to these models on the `trtllm` backends; this builds on that work and supplies the pieces the triton path additionally needs: - The triton sparse-MLA kernel now returns its LSE(Log-Sum-Exp), so the per-rank partials can be merged. - The HIP FP8 KV cache now works under DCP: writes land on the row the reader looks up. - Fixes the GPU memory access fault the ROCm DSA MTP draft hit under DCP, by putting the draft on the target's sharding and addressing rule. ## Correctness MI355X, `amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4`, TP4/EP4, FP8 KV, MTP (EAGLE, 5 steps, 6 draft tokens), real draft acceptance. | check | no DCP | PR after; DCP=4 | |---|---|---| | passkey 8K / 34K / 96K | 3/3 | 3/3 | | GSM8K (400 questions, few-shot) | 0.953 | 0.953 | | MTP accept length (4 prompts x 400 tokens, greedy) | 3.11 | 3.47 | | KV capacity (tokens) | 2.83M | 8.81M (2.20M rows per rank x 4) | The FP8 write kernel test passes with 4 simulated ranks, and the triton LSE matches at the kernel level. ## Performance InferenceX agentic replay on this head, TP4/EP4 + DCP4 with MTP (simulated AL 3.61), 1 h per point. All four points finish with no GPU fault. The TP4 rows without DCP but with HiCache are for reference only. Puts the ROCm DSA draft on the target's allocator page and owner rule, with extend on the owned-slot path. Performance: - **`Bound the triton DCP sparse-MLA scan by the owned top-k count`** 171e960082 - `localize_dcp_page_table` already returns the per-row owned count, but the triton path dropped it and scanned all top-k slots, masking about (W-1)/W of them. The kernels now stop after the owned tiles. - **`Split DSA prefill indexer rows across the DCP group`** d7f9605feb - DCP now splits the rows evenly across ranks instead of computing the same top-k `W` times. The results are all-gathered directly into the destination buffer when possible. - **`Gather the DSA DCP Q in the FP8 KV dtype`** b8a0a1ac70 - Halves the Q traffic between DCP ranks with no change in results, because the kernel converted Q to that same format on arrival anyway. On ROCm, pass `--dsa-prefill-backend triton --dsa-decode-backend triton`, because #43735 defaults to `trtllm` when they are unset. ## Known issues - DCP rejects HiCache, so once the DCP pool is full (c48 above), evicted prefixes are recomputed rather than reloaded from host. +@triton.jit
+def _dcp_pack_q_kernel(
+    q_nope_ptr,
+    q_pe_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    nope_stride_B,
+    nope_stride_H,
+    pe_stride_B,
+    pe_stride_H,
+    out_stride_H,
+    out_stride_B,
+    D_NOPE: tl.constexpr,
+    D_PE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """One (batch, head) row of ``[q_pe | q_nope]``, cast to the output dtype."""
+    b = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    h = tl.program_id(1).to(tl.int64)
+    out_ty = out_ptr.dtype.element_ty
+    dst = out_ptr + h * out_stride_H + b * out_stride_B
+    pe = tl.arange(0, D_PE)
+    q_pe = tl.load(q_pe_ptr + b * pe_stride_B + h * pe_stride_H + pe)
+    tl.store(dst + pe, q_pe.to(out_ty))
+    nope = tl.arange(0, D_NOPE)
+    q_nope = tl.load(q_nope_ptr + b * nope_stride_B + h * nope_stride_H + nope)
+    tl.store(dst + D_PE + nope, q_nope.to(out_ty))
+
